title: Coastal Cornerstone Construction dataset coverage

sections.heading: Homepage and company overview
sections.text: Covers general construction services, location in Clearwater, Florida, and the types of projects (commercial, industrial, government, residential). Useful for questions about the company’s core business and experience.

sections.heading: About, experience, and value engineering
sections.text: The dataset covers team experience, value engineering, project communication, and the capability statement. It explains how to start an estimating conversation; it does not publish project prices.

sections.heading: Residential, commercial, and project types
sections.text: Explains custom home building, renovations, additions, and commercial project types (offices, retail, government, industrial). Also covers work in coastal and remote locations. Answers scope-related and project-type questions.

sections.heading: ICF construction and building performance
sections.text: The dataset explains the nine ICF benefits, including storm resilience, quiet, potential energy savings, moisture management, and seasonal comfort. Questions requiring project-specific engineering need the design team.

sections.heading: Process and contact information
sections.text: The dataset describes scope review, planning, trade coordination, business hours, and contact methods. Questions about a project’s current schedule or a binding estimate need a direct discussion with the team.

report_kind: Initial source coverage; not real-traffic analysis
